description: Super于1937年推出的旁轴相机。快门速度Tessar 2.8/8.0 cm lens in a Compur-Rapid shutter。使用6 x 6 cm on 120 type rollfilm。

specs.快门: Tessar 2.8/8.0 cm lens in a Compur-Rapid shutter
specs.闪光灯: Socket on shutter, X-synchronisation. Synchro-Compur also M-synchronisation
specs.取景器: reverse Galilean type, integrated in top cover
specs.英文简介: The 532/16 is a folding camera in the Ikonta line, produced by the German company Zeiss Ikon from 1937-1955.
